name: overpower
description: Proportional plan-and-build workflow: spec, research, tool-scout, plan, preflight, TDD, subagents, debugging, code review, live dashboard.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for overpower skills:
- "ask the user" → AskUserQuestion, 1-4 questions, 2-4 options each, recommended option first.
- "dispatch a subagent" → Agent: subagent_type "coder" for implementer/reviewer briefs, "explore" for read-only search, "plan" for design or plan critique. Paste the full brief into prompt.
- "load a skill" → the Skill tool.
- "todo list" → TodoList.
- Use Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, FetchURL, WebSearch and MCP tools by their real names.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, verify, build, debug and review — as much process as the task needs
